title: Terms and Conditions
overview: On the night of their anniversary, Angela visits her boyfriend Micheal for what should be a romantic celebration. But beneath the warmth of their relationship lies a disturbing secret. As hidden truths about manipulation, surveillance, and betrayal come to light, their intimate dinner date descends into a deadly confrontation. Terms and Conditions is a tense psychological thriller exploring control, obsession, and the dangerous price of love on someone else's terms.
